newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CCP deposit cost falls in March vs Feb.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CCP deposit cost falls in March vs Feb.

text.p: Mexico's CCP, the average bank term deposit cost measured in pesos in Mexican banks, slipped to 21.82 percent in March from 22.09 percent in February, the central bank said Tuesday.
Banco de Mexico also said that the CCP-UDIs, the CCP measured in UDIs, an inflation-indexed investment unit, was at 6.42 percent for March, compared to 6.32 percent in the previous month.
The bank publishes the various rates to give a better idea of the cost of borrowing, and so banks can use them as reference rates.
